unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: Can't reach usmfomo. Check your connection and try again.
service_restricted: usmfomo is temporarily limited. Please try again later.
not_allowed: You're not allowed to do that. Your account may be paused or your session may have ended — sign in again.
session_ended: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
mfa_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app to continue.
posting_paused: Posting is paused by the usmfomo admin. Your live posts stay visible.
quota_live: You already have 15 live posts. Delete one or wait until one ends.
quota_daily: You've made 5 new posts in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
quota_edits: You've reached 30 edits in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
end_in_past: The event must end in the future (at least 15 minutes from now for a new post).
start_too_early: The new start time can't be more than an hour in the past.
start_too_late: The event's start date can't be more than a year from now.
too_long: This post would stay up too long. Create a new post for the next event.
path_invalid: The poster upload failed. Please choose the image again.
owner_only: Only the usmfomo admin can do that.
title_length: The event name must be 3–100 characters.
description_length: The description can be at most 1,000 characters.
link_format: Use a full https:// link (for example https://forms.gle/…).
date_format: Enter a valid date and time.
end_before_start: The end must be after the start.
too_long_event: An event can last at most 31 days.
too_long_notice: A notice can show for at most 180 days.
poster_pair: The poster upload is incomplete. Please choose the image again.
slug_format: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only.
campus_physical: Choose a physical campus for the organisation.
auth_paused: This account is paused — contact the usmfomo admin.
auth_bad_code: That code didn't work — use the newest code and check your phone's clock.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
file_too_big: That file is over 10 MB. Choose a smaller image.
file_type: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image. (For PDF or HEIC, export as JPG or PNG first.)
image_decode: That image couldn't be read. Try exporting it again as JPG or PNG.
image_too_big_after: That image is too detailed to shrink enough. Try a simpler or smaller image.
